items.label: Your pick: the eighth with the sub bloom (the base for all below)
+ whispers (breath through a voice's vowels, ah to oo: ghostly voices, no pitch)
+ pre-verb (the air's own echo played backwards, arriving out of nothing into the bloom)
+ swirl (the air through a slowly sweeping comb: an otherworldly phasing)
+ throb (the bloom two tones a hair apart, beating: the pressure pulsing as it fades)
+ chamber (the air ringing a stone hall's resonances, inharmonic, no chord)
+ hover (the air held and smeared after the bloom, as if time slowed)
+ sweep and draw (from an earlier round: across, and drawn in to the bloom)
